title: Conversation 2026-11-02: the site editor on srs-web, every page and the menu

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner asked to look at the muDemocracy site editor: every page and the menu (with dropdowns) managed through it, styleguide first, DRY code, and the editor sitting fully on srs-web. Claude Code explored the prototype and srs-web's editor registry and proposed a plan; the owner asked how the editor manages packages and the link between package and site components.
